response_json.summary: This is a draft review summary for an AP duplicate/suspicious payment review. The deterministic findings list 15 findings across 9 rule types: duplicate_invoice_number (1), invoice_paid_by_multiple_checks (2), same_vendor_same_amount_near_date (4), similar_vendor_names_same_amount (1), missing_po_over_threshold (1), payment_before_invoice_date (1), inactive_vendor_payment (1), unknown_vendor_payment (1), and split_payment_pattern (3). Severity totals are high: 8 and medium: 7. All findings are marked requires_human_review = true. No fraud conclusion is made and no new figures are calculated in this draft.

categorized_exceptions.description: Draft note: vendor V-1001 invoice INV-10234 appears on 2 AP rows [46, 47], each with amount 1250.00. This requires human review to confirm whether the same invoice was entered or paid twice.

Draft note: invoice INV-10234 was paid by 2 different checks: ['50012', '50044'] on rows [46, 47]. Separately, invoice 5521 was paid by 2 different checks: ['50161', '50165'] on rows [50, 51]. This requires human review to verify whether multiple checks against one invoice are supported.

Draft note: check 50190 date 2026-05-12 is before invoice INV-55003 date 2026-05-20 for vendor V-1006. This requires human review to confirm whether the payment date or invoice date is correct and whether any prepayment was authorized.

Draft note: vendor V-1007 has multiple invoices each below 5000.00 within 3 days: INV-88001 and INV-88002 totaling 9800.00; INV-88001, INV-88002, and INV-88003 totaling 14700.00; and INV-88002 and INV-88003 totaling 9800.00. All invoice dates are 2026-02-17. This requires human review to determine whether these are legitimate separate purchases or a split-payment pattern.
